audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 was scored for Trundle. The mirror at audits/top/trundle__singed.json sets Level 6 to Skill on his side, and this page's own whys[4] describes a trade-off rather than a loss.
audit.why: Subjugate strips resistances but Insanity Potion arrives on the same level and puts Grievous Wounds on your poison, which cuts King's Tribute and the increased healing Frozen Domain gives him. Both ultimates cancel out — that is an even stage. Trundle's own page already reads Skill there, so the directions must agree.
audit.corrected: win[4] and phases[4].side set to Skill. Chart now reads Trundle / Skill / Singed / Singed / Skill / Singed / Singed on both sides.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns was template filler, and no ability on the page carried a number.
audit.why: Chomp is 3.5s — effectively always available, so 'stacking bites' is not a window you wait out. Frozen Domain is 18s at rank 1, Pillar of Ice 21s at rank 1 at 1000 range, Subjugate 120s at rank 1 against Insanity Potion's flat 100s. Your ultimate returns twenty seconds before his does.
audit.corrected: Real rank-1 numbers written into breakdown.cooldowns, mid and wants.foe[2].

audit.whatIsWrong: Insanity Potion's Grievous Wounds is never connected to Trundle's healing anywhere on the page — in the matchup where it matters most.
audit.why: King's Tribute heals him for a percent of maximum health every time a unit dies near him, and Frozen Domain gives 'increased healing from all sources'. Insanity Potion makes Poison Trail apply Grievous Wounds, so it turns off the passive and the amplifier at once. The mirror identified the same interaction from Trundle's side.
audit.corrected: Written into whys[4], spikes[1], mid and breakdown.cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two strings say Trundle 'out-sustains your chip with his passive' as if King's Tribute were combat regeneration.
audit.why: Riot: 'When an enemy unit dies near Trundle, he heals for a percent of its maximum Health.' It only fires off dying units. He sustains by standing on farm, which means proxying the wave away from him is itself the anti-sustain play, and a Trundle denied minions has no passive healing at all. The page described a mechanic that does not exist and missed the counterplay attached to the real one.
audit.corrected: whys[0] and early restated around minion deaths.

audit.whatIsWrong: mid asserts 'Subjugate will strip 20% of your armor and MR on cast', and early says he 'cannot dash out of Mega Adhesive's root'.
audit.why: No percentage for Subjugate appears anywhere in the kit file, so the 20% is unsourced; what the file does say is that it steals Health as well as Armor and MR, and that the amount is doubled over the following 4 seconds — both omitted. Separately Trundle has no dash in his kit at all, so 'cannot dash out' is a non-interaction taking up space.
audit.corrected: The invented percentage removed and replaced with the health theft and the 4-second doubling; the dash line replaced with what the root actually buys you.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing on the page warns against building resistances into Trundle.
audit.why: King's Tribute is flagged percentHealth, 'punishes HP stacking', and Subjugate steals a percent of Health, Armor and Magic Resistance — doubled over 4 seconds. Every point of armour and MR you stack is a point he takes off you and adds to himself. Raw resistances are the wrong answer in this lane and the page never said so.

edits.before: Ult-ghost-proxy is a macro weapon — you win by farming where he is not. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Trundle's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Both ultimates land at 6 and cancel: Subjugate takes your resists, Insanity Potion puts Grievous Wounds on the poison and cuts King's Tribute.

edits.before: Trundle's Chomp Q steals your AD on hit and he out-sustains Poison Trail chip with his passive — concede the duel and farm passively rather than feeding him early bite stacks.
edits.after: Trundle's Chomp saps your AD every 3.5 seconds and King's Tribute heals him off each dying minion — concede the duel, farm passively, and take his wave away from him instead.

edits.before: Insanity Potion's stat dump is real, but so is Subjugate's resistance drain — ghost the cast animation and make him chase poison rather than standing and trading resistances.
edits.after: Subjugate steals health and resistances, doubled over 4 seconds — but Insanity Potion's Grievous Wounds cuts King's Tribute and the healing Frozen Domain amplifies. Kite, do not trade.

edits.before: Trundle's Subjugate spike is real — if he lands it while you're in Insanity Potion, he strips your MR and armor simultaneously; ghost out the moment the cast animation starts.
edits.after: Both ultimates land at 6 — Subjugate steals health and resists over 4 seconds, while Insanity Potion puts Grievous Wounds on your poison and turns off King's Tribute. Kite, do not stand.

edits.before: Level 1 is Trundle's best window — his Chomp Q steals attack damage on contact and he out-sustains your chip with his passive. Don't auto-trade; just farm at the back of the wave and let Poison Trail tick passively if he steps into it. At level 2 Fling comes online but he can still out-brawl you if he's healthy, so use E only to send him away from you, never to initiate a sustained fight. Level 3 is where the lane starts to flip: W-glue under his feet, E-Fling him toward your tower, and run — he has to eat Poison Trail the entire time he chases, and he cannot dash out of Mega Adhesive's root.
edits.after: Level 1 is Trundle's best window — Chomp saps your attack damage every 3.5 seconds and King's Tribute heals him off every minion that dies near him. Don't auto-trade; farm at the back of the wave and let Poison Trail tick if he steps into it. At level 2 Fling comes online but he can still out-brawl you if he's healthy, so use E only to send him away, never to initiate. Level 3 is where the lane flips: W-glue under his feet, E-Fling him toward your tower, and run — he eats Poison Trail the whole chase, and with no mobility in his kit the root simply holds him there.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 are your proxy window — get behind the enemy wave under their tower, activate Ghost, and force Trundle to choose between farming and chasing a Singed who is eating his minions alive. His Pillar of Ice is a meaningful threat here: if he places it to cut off your escape path while his W zone is active, you can get pinned, so always have an exit angle before you proxy deep. At level 6 both ultimates change the math — Insanity Potion makes you suddenly beefy enough to absorb Chomp bites without instantly losing the duel, but Subjugate will strip 20% of your armor and MR on cast, so the moment you see his R animation ghost toward your tower and make him chase through Poison Trail instead of the other way around.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 are your proxy window — get behind the enemy wave under their tower, activate Ghost, and force Trundle to choose between farming and chasing you. Denying him the wave is itself anti-sustain: King's Tribute only heals him when a unit dies nearby. Pillar of Ice is the real threat, 21s at rank 1 and thrown from 1000 range as impassable terrain, so always have an exit angle before you proxy deep. At level 6 both ultimates change the math — Subjugate steals health and resistances and doubles the theft over 4 seconds, but Insanity Potion puts Grievous Wounds on Poison Trail, cutting the healing Frozen Domain amplifies. Ghost the moment you see his R and make him chase through the cloud.
